//: These settings are easier to change in-game! Mod List -> GUI Clock -> Config

Enable GUI Clock.//: Whether GUI Clock is enabled. When disabled, none of its features run and its other settings are hidden. Takes effect after a restart.

mustHaveClockInInventoryForGameTime.//: When enabled, will only show the game time when a clock is present in the inventory.

mustHaveClockInInventoryForRealTime.//: When enabled, will only show the real time when a clock is present in the inventory.

lowerClockWhenPlayerHasEffects.//: Whether the clock in the GUI should be lowered when the player has potion effects to prevent overlap.

_24hourformat.//: Sets the format of the clock to the 24-hour format.

showOnlyMinecraftClockIcon.//: When enabled, shows the clock item icon instead of a clock with numbers.

showBothTimes.//: Show both in-game time and real local time.

showRealTime.//: Show actual local time instead of in-game time.

showRealTimeSeconds.//: Show the seconds in the clock.

showDaysPlayedWorld.//: Show the days played in the world.

minuteStep.//: Rounds the in-game minutes down to a multiple of this value. For example, 15 shows 6:00, 6:15, 6:30 and 6:45. 1 shows every minute. min: 1, max: 60

clockPosition.//: Where the clock is shown at the top of the screen. options: Left, Center, Right

clockHeightOffset.//: The vertical offset (y coord) for the Clock. This determines how far down the time should be on the screen. Can be changed to prevent GUIs from overlapping. min: 0, max: 3,000

clockWidthOffset.//: The horizontal offset (x coord) for the Clock. min: -3,000, max: 3,000

drawTextShadow.//: If the text displayed should have a shadow drawn below it.

RGB.//: The colour of the clock text, as red, green and blue values from 0 to 255.
